decisions.briefing: Markets were broadly neutral today (NASDAQ +0.3%, S&P 500 +0.4%), so most candidates don't warrant action, but TSLA and ERAS both show the full four-signal confirmation (RSI, MACD, price vs SMA-20, and volume surge) that has historically marked genuine institutional buying rather than noise. We used two of the three open slots on these high-conviction setups and left the third slot open rather than forcing a buy into a weaker candidate.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with the S&P 500 up 0.4% and the Nasdaq up 0.3%, reflecting a quiet, low-volatility session without a clear macro catalyst. Trading stayed range-bound as investors appeared to await fresh economic data or earnings before committing to a stronger directional move. A handful of individual names, including TSLA and ERAS, stood out with stronger-than-market momentum on elevated volume.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和偏多,標普500指數上升0.4%,納斯達克指數上升0.3%,屬於缺乏明確催化劑的低波動交投。大市呈現區間震盪格局,投資者似乎在等待新的經濟數據或企業盈利公佈後才會有更明確方向。個別股份如TSLA及ERAS在成交量放大下表現明顯強於大市。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of acting on just one bullish indicator, strong traders look for several signals to line up at once — like RSI in a healthy range, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge. When all of these agree, it suggests real buying interest rather than a random price blip.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 強勢的交易者不會只靠單一指標行動,而是等待多個訊號同時出現 — 例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於移動平均線,以及成交量放大。當這些訊號同時成立時,代表市場上有真實的買盤,而不只是隨機的價格波動。
